title: Great app
body: Great app! I would purchase the annual plan if it were 499 instead of 1299, ive synced it to my calendar today and hope to log events regularly.
author: Captainlionel

title: Quite promising
body:
Have been trying to get my hands on an app to keep track of my goals and how to use habits to get there.  Essentially build a life strategy. 
Tried a couple of apps. Grit seems by far the most promising of the lot. 
Let us see if Grit can keep me hooked. 

By the way, we should also add goals to this app. 
For example: running marathon on my 50th birthday could be a goal. But I need the habit of running 3-4 times a week to get there. So far, it’s focused on the latter.
author: Axayg

title: Great application for keeping a tab on my progress
body:
I love all the features. From the most basic to the most advanced. It has all the features I needed it to have. If you're tired of looking for the perfect tracker. This has got it all. Although I would love if you add some keyboard shortcuts for the app. I'm tired of clicking exactly on the cross to exit. I just want to click in the random space to exit the edit settings. 

PS. I have purchased the subscription. Without subscription you're only allowed I think 3 habits.
